reason: Test-only repair of 42 runtime-area tests that an independent validator classified as stale test code (class a) on origin/main. #939 (831d0d0): the host CPU budget and report CPU activation helpers now await AsyncTestClient. test_setup no longer uses a blocking snapshot stub, session.query, the removed Database._run_alembic_migrations hook or an unstarted client lifespan, and the idle-image test shuts down its SetupService. 64e0379 (deliberate memory-runner hold): report CPU workers and the activation render step assert the hold's contract (durable failed render with no rendering event, a blocked unreserved report_pdf memory job, no PDF, pool never started or dispatched; explicit retries are held again) instead of rendering through an affinity-only pool. 17ec988: the API worker's RuntimeDelivery is bound to its own store's database. 3f67ca7: PreparedChat stand-ins carry source_request=None. fa88f37: an API peer's host-memory call is a 404 from its Work-batch-only RPC server. c8b91c8: runner availability is stubbed so the inert profile stays verified. e9cca0c: Library item reads go through the API worker's RuntimeGlobalApi. #143: a 0o400 blob is made writable before it is corrupted. 639c378: the retained setup journey admits its workers. aedf0c7 (#1019): a ShutdownBlocked receipt is failed and names the project. Selected: every repaired file, whole where every case passes on the branch, otherwise by node id.
exclusions: Not selected because they fail identically on clean main and on this branch, for reasons outside this change: test_setup.py::test_image_preparation_reports_phases_can_cancel_and_retry (class b product race in setup.py _emit/phase ordering, left unchanged for the product fix; when it fails it also leaks its SetupService connection and hangs interpreter exit). test_runtime_host_services.py::test_host_synchronizes_current_product_guidance_and_preserves_it_on_restart and ::test_guidance_mirror_failure_is_reported_while_packaged_help_remains_available (FileNotFoundError: they need the generated product_knowledge.sqlite3.b85, which CI builds only for the retained-process suites). test_runtime_host_operator.py::test_authenticated_nonloopback_host_folder_journey (class c: needs a non-loopback address for this host's name). test_runtime_processes.py::test_two_failed_real_starts_do_not_prevent_a_later_version and ::test_nonreading_bootstrap_child_cannot_block_supervisor_timeouts were already repaired on main by #1057, so they are not touched or selected here. Not repaired (class c): test_runtime_continuity_acceptance.py and test_runtime_work_batch_integration.py::test_retained_cli_import_progresses_without_api_and_keeps_batch_receipts need chromadb in the interpreter's own site-packages or NEBULA_ACCEPTANCE_DEPENDENCIES. Also class c: test_runtime_host_knowledge_bootstrap LAN sync and test_shutdown_readmission need a non-loopback hostname. Class d (host load or a product exit race): retained-worker startup deadlines in test_execution_worker_process (4), test_runtime_bootstrap, test_runtime_host_search_process, test_runtime_host_settings, test_runtime_integration_credentials and test_runtime_worker_features. Also class d: the intermittent exit hang from RuntimeSupervisor.close() cancelling an aiosqlite connect, seen in the test_runtime_browser_bridge and test_runtime_host_operator files. Process-level suites ran with a worktree-bound Python 3.12 venv; Postgres parameters of the two chat runtime files also ran on a private database (none of the selected files triggers CI's PostgreSQL job). No UI, native or Playwright cases: only Python tests changed. No real-Core evidence: test-only change.
